book.name: Galesia
book.title: Galesia Pol Galesia nɨbi bɨ kalɨp köp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Yad Pol, bɨ Jisas manö ud arep ap mɨdpin. Pen wög gɨpin anɨbu, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap haglö aka gasɨ yad ke nɨŋem gagpin; Jisas Krais abe, Nap nɨp gö uraka u abe, kale apil mɨhau nöp haglö gɨpin.
Hon añ mam Krais pɨg mɨdpun gai i, kalöp añ mam Krais lau adö Galesia Propins mɨdpim gau, “Kale mɨdpim?” a gabun.
Bap God abe, Bɨ Kub hon Jisas Krais abe, kalöp mög nɨŋmil abad mɨdlö mɨd aij gɨmim.

Hon nan si nan naij göl gɨ mɨdaino pen Bɨ Kub hon Jisas Krais, Bap hon God haga manö u udöm, nan si nan naij gɨpun gau prɨ u ƚɨk gɨ yunam, a göm, hanɨp nan a göm ilön udöm uma. Uma u, nɨbi bɨ nan si nan naij gɨmɨdal aŋ gau mɨdaino, hanɨp ud kamɨŋ yunɨg uma.
Anɨb u, God Bap hon hib nɨpe u pör pör nöp hagno adö arnɨm. Anɨb unbö rö aij.
Jisas hanɨp nan a göm uma manö aij anɨbu nöp nɨŋ udun

Yad gasɨ iru yabɨƚ nɨŋbin. God kalöp mög nɨŋöm, Jisas nɨp hagö, kalöp a göm uma u pen yɨŋɨd nöp God nɨp arö gɨmim, manö aij nɨpe u arö gɨmim, manö hain nɨbö ke daubal rɨmnap, manö i manö aij, a gɨmim, nɨŋ udnɨg gabim.
Manö anɨbu, Krais manö aij u wasö; yɨharɨŋ nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap apöm, manö piral ke nɨbö rɨmnap kalöp haglö, kale dui gɨmim, “Manö anɨbu nɨŋun aka?” gɨmim gasɨ u nɨŋabim.

Krais manö aij kalöp nöd hag ñɨno u, manö nɨŋö yabɨƚ u hag ñɨno. Pen hon ke aka ejol kumi kabö adö laŋ nɨbö ap apöm, manö ke nɨbö manö piral rɨmnap kalöp hag ñɨnab u, God bɨ anɨbu hagö mab ke pör inab u aram pör pör nöp au mɨdnab u aij.

Manö anɨbu kalöp kauyaŋ hagabin. Bɨ ap apöm, manö aij nöd nɨŋ udpe u ba gau löm, manö ke nɨbö manö piral rɨmnap kalöp hag ñɨnab u, God bɨ anɨbu hagö mab ke pör inab u aram pör pör nöp au mɨdnab u aij.

Manö hagabin anɨbi, nɨbi bɨ gau hib yad u haglö adö araŋ, a gem, hagagabin. God yɨp nɨŋöm ñɨñɨ lɨnɨm a gem hagabin. Yad nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp wañ wañ göl gɨ hagagabin. Ai gɨnɨg: yad anɨg gem wañ wañ göl gɨ hagbnep u, Krais wög gɨ ñeb bɨ nɨpe ap mɨdagbnep.
God nöp hagö Pol wög nɨpe gɨmɨdöp
Añ mam bɨ. Yad kalöp nɨŋö hagabin. Manö aij kalöp nöd hag ñɨnö u, nɨbi bɨ manö hagpal rö wasö.
Manö anɨbu, bɨ ap hagö nɨŋagnö; manö anɨbu bɨ ap yɨp hag ñö udagnö. Jisas Krais nɨpe ke nöp yɨp waiö hag ñö nɨŋnö.
Pen nöd yad Juda nɨbi bɨ gasɨ nɨŋmɨdal rö gasɨ nɨŋmɨdin u, kale nɨŋbim. God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe gau böŋ nöp umlaŋ, a gem, kalɨp gɨ naij yabɨƚ gɨmɨdin.
Bac bɨ manö u nɨŋ udem, kƚö yabɨƚ gɨmɨdin; bɨ Juda yad aip adɨp adɨp kub gɨno gau, kale gɨmɨdal rö wasö, yad añɨ Juda lo manö nɨŋ aij yabɨƚ gem, bac bɨ hagmɨdal rö kƚö gem gɨmɨdin.
Pen ami yɨp yag dauaga ñɨn u, God yɨp mög nɨŋöm ud wög gɨ ñeb bɨ nɨpe ap hag la. Hainö kub gɨnö, God nɨpe ke aij ga ñɨn u nöp,

Ñɨ yad Jisas Pol nɨp yamnö, nɨŋ aij göm, Juda nɨbi bɨ wasö gau kalɨp manö aij yad u hag ñɨ aij gɨnab, a göm, Ñɨ nɨpe yɨp yamö, nɨŋ aij gɨnö. Anɨg gö, Jisas manö u aigege rö mɨdöp, a gem, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap hag nɨŋagnö.
Pen Jisas nöd hag lö manö aij ud arep bɨ nɨpe mɨdeila gau kalɨp nɨŋnam, a gem, Jerusalem aragnö. Yɨharɨŋ ram mɨnöŋ mɨlö kub Arebia am mɨdem, ado gɨ apem, daun kub Damaskas mɨdmɨdin.
Mɨ mɨhau nɨgaŋ inö, Pida Jerusalem mɨdeia u nɨŋnɨg amem, nɨpe aip ñɨn iru mɨdagainö; yɨharɨŋ ñɨn unbö ajɨp böŋ daŋ mɨdainö.
Pen yad bɨ Jisas manö ud arep rɨmnap halö nɨŋagnö; Pida aip Jisas nɨmam Jems aip kalɨp nöp nɨŋnö.
Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkabin anɨbi, God nɨŋ mɨdöp u, kalöp nɨŋö yabɨƚ hagabin.
Pen yad hainö Siria Propins amem, Silisia Propins amem, gɨnö.
Nöd ñɨn anɨbu, nɨbi bɨ Krais lau adö Judia ram mɨnöŋ pro ke ke mɨdeila gau amgö magö kale u yɨp nɨŋagla u
pen nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap manö yad u yag damöm hagla, “Bɨ Jisas manö aij nɨpe u hag juöm, hanɨp gɨ naij göm gɨmɨdöp bɨ u, mɨñi Jisas manö aij u nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp hag ñɨ ajab,” a gɨlö
nɨŋöm God hib nɨpe u haglö adö armɨdöp.
